item.evidence: casino/php-project/slot.php:54-59 and index.php:118-124 render provider images in rb-wgc-card; css/rubin-theme.css:371-372 forces aspect-ratio: 3 / 4 and object-fit: cover !important, overriding the earlier contain rule at :365; inc/wgc.php:96 only rewrites URLs matching one square URL pattern.
item.expected: R-074: "Each /slot tile displays the whole source image, including the provider logo drawn inside it, with no crop, zoom or blur frame"; request: "оставь их ... чтобы они полностью были видны". Fit the whole image into the vertical tile without clipping.
item.observed: Layout, theme, visuals and UX: any provider image whose native ratio is not exactly 3:4 is enlarged and clipped by cover, cutting its top/bottom or sides, including any logo near an edge. This directly defeats the player's requested whole artwork on both lobby surfaces; the code cannot guarantee that all provider URLs have the rewritten portrait pattern.
reproduction_steps: Open /slot or the home popular slots.
View a game whose provider image is square or another non-3:4 aspect ratio.
Compare its artwork and edge logo with the original image.
item.surface: Home popular slots and /slot game grid
item.title: Slot artwork and logos are cropped — the final tile rule uses cover inside a portrait frame

item.evidence: wgc_wallet.php:101-105 records an accepted bet for tracking; :114-129 reverses balance and marks rolled_back but never changes wager; :138-140 calls bwTrackBet only for the original bet. inc/rtp.php:55-61 increments wager_progress and clears wager_required and marks promos done at the threshold.
item.expected: R-096: "A bet placed through a WGC slot round increases the active wager progress by that bet amount exactly once per round id, and a rollback reverses that increase". Restore progress and any completed wager status transactionally on rollback.
item.observed: Business logic and calculations: a provider rollback refunds the bet but leaves its wager contribution, and if that bet completed the requirement it remains marked completed. A player can be allowed to withdraw despite not completing the actual qualifying bets, creating material financial loss to the operator; an affected player also sees inaccurate progress.
reproduction_steps: Activate a promo with an unfinished wager.
Place a slot bet, then have WGC roll back that transaction.
Open the profile and compare active wager progress with the remaining non-rolled-back bets; check withdrawal eligibility if the bet crossed the threshold.
item.surface: WGC wallet rollback; profile active wager and withdrawal eligibility
item.title: Rolled-back slot bets still count toward bonus wagering — rollback never reverses wager progress

item.evidence: wgc_wallet.php:101-112 saves balance and transaction; :131 commits; :138-140 invokes bwTrackBet after commit inside a catch that ignores exceptions. On retry :88-94 reads the stored answer without setting $track; inc/rtp.php:55-61 performs wager updates separately.
item.expected: R-096: "A bet placed through a WGC slot round increases the active wager progress by that bet amount exactly once"; checklist, Data, persistence and APIs: "A save that writes several documents ... leaves no half-written state when one write fails".
item.observed: Data, persistence and APIs: if tracking fails or the worker stops after the transaction commits, a real stake has been taken but no progress is recorded; a provider retry returns the saved success without repairing progress. The player must wager more than required and can be wrongly blocked from withdrawing, with no user-side safe repair.
reproduction_steps: Activate a promo with an unfinished wager.
Place a real slot bet while the wager update fails or the callback worker stops after committing the wallet transaction.
Allow WGC to retry the transaction and open the profile; the accepted bet is not added to progress.
item.surface: WGC wallet writeBet and profile wager
item.title: Players can lose wager progress after an accepted slot bet — balance commits before wager tracking

item.evidence: wgc_wallet.php:101-103 applies bal - bet + win; :119-123 computes max(0, bal + bet - win), saves it and marks the transaction rolled back even if the exact reversal would be negative.
item.expected: R-093: "the player's stored balance after the round equals the stored transactions applied in order, to the kopeck"; R-094: "stored balance ... equals the previous balance minus the bet plus the win". Account for the entire reversal or explicitly reject and reconcile it rather than silently losing the amount.
item.observed: Business logic and calculations: when a player wins, spends some of the winnings on a later round, and the provider rolls back the original win, the exact reversal can be negative. The code silently erases that deficit and declares a full rollback; the wallet and provider ledger diverge, potentially leaving the operator to fund winnings already spent.
reproduction_steps: Have a player win a slot round, then spend part of those winnings in another round.
Have the provider roll back the winning transaction when the current balance is less than win minus bet.
Compare the transaction ledger with the balance reported by the rollback.
item.title: A winning round rollback can leave the player's balance materially wrong — the reversal is silently capped at zero

item.evidence: inc/wgc.php:8-21 reads process environment or /app/backend/.env for WGC_API_KEY and SLOTS_API_SECRET; the supplied backend/.env defines only MONGO_URL, DB_NAME and CORS_ORIGINS, and start-emergent.sh:1-27 does not set the WGC values. inc/wgc.php:29 returns no_api_key, playslot.php:18-34 displays a launch error, and wgc_wallet.php:23-24 returns server_misconfigured without a callback secret.
item.expected: R-133: "Every configuration value the slots integration reads ... exists in the preview environment and the integration runs with it"; R-071 requires a playable RUB provider session.
item.observed: Build, deployment and environment: the supplied file and startup script do not provide the two credentials. If they are not injected externally into the PHP process, every signed-in player's slot launch fails and every wallet callback is rejected, so the requested real-money game cannot be played. The source review cannot establish whether an external process environment injects them.
reproduction_steps: Deploy using the supplied startup script and .env without separately injected WGC credentials.
Sign in, open /slot and select a game.
Observe the launch error; the admin slots page reports the key and callback secret missing.
item.title: Players cannot start real RUB slots when the supplied keys are absent from deployment configuration — the launch and callback depend on unprovided environment values

item.evidence: action.php:1867-1872 inserts the submitted password directly into kot_user.pass; :1883-1886 and :1915-1923 compare the supplied password directly in SQL. admin/admin_func.php:75-77 also saves administrator-set passwords un-hashed; dizmaname1.sql:230-234 defines the pass field.
item.expected: Checklist, Auth, sessions and access control: "stores the password hashed, and never returns the hash". Store a salted password hash with a suitable password hashing algorithm and verify it at login.
item.observed: Auth, sessions and access control: every user's password is stored in recoverable form, including administrator credentials. A database or backup disclosure exposes reusable passwords and permits access to players' monetary balances and potentially administrator functions; no data exposure is claimed to have been observed at runtime.
reproduction_steps: Register an account using the login modal.
Inspect the corresponding stored kot_user.pass field.
Compare it to the password entered; administrator password changes use the same plaintext storage.
item.surface: Registration, sign-in, admin player password editing
item.title: Players' accounts and balances are exposed if the database is read — registration and login store and compare plaintext passwords

item.evidence: action.php:1933 copies $_POST['del'] directly; :1944 interpolates it into SELECT * FROM kot_withdraws WHERE id='$id_delete'; :1958 checks ownership only of the returned row; :1964 interpolates the same value into DELETE FROM kot_withdraws WHERE id = '$id_delete'. No cast or parameter binding occurs.
item.expected: R-118: "A signed-in player requesting another player's ... withdrawals ... by changing an id is refused"; checklist, Auth, sessions and access control: "SQL ... strings built from user input are injectable". Bind a numeric ID and constrain the mutation to that user's pending withdrawal atomically.
item.observed: Auth, sessions and access control: a caller able to submit a manipulated cancellation identifier can change the predicates of both SQL statements. A matching owned withdrawal can satisfy the one-row ownership check while the DELETE affects other withdrawal rows, destroying players' payout records and the operator's audit trail. The source establishes the injectable path; no request was executed.
reproduction_steps: Sign in with a pending withdrawal.
Submit the legacy deletewithdraw action with a manipulated withdrawal identifier rather than a plain record number.
The same unbound identifier is used in the SELECT and DELETE after a single-row ownership check.
item.title: Withdrawal records can be altered or deleted outside their owner — cancellation interpolates an unvalidated ID into SQL

item.evidence: inc/payments.php:123-124 changes a pending invoice to paid and returns false for any later attempt; :125-132 then separately updates the player's balance and inserts the deposit ledger with no transaction or checked writes. payhook.php:15-18 and payapi.php:33-40 invoke this path.
item.expected: R-125: "A cashier deposit invoice confirmed by CryptoBot or xRocket credits the RUB balance exactly once, to the kopeck"; checklist, Data, persistence and APIs: a multi-record save must leave no half-written state.
item.observed: Payments and billing: if the worker stops or a database operation fails after marking an invoice paid, the player's real payment is not credited, but retries refuse to perform the credit and the cashier reports paid. The player loses access to deposited funds and cannot repair the record through the cashier.
reproduction_steps: Create and pay a configured crypto deposit invoice.
Interrupt the worker or encounter a database failure immediately after the invoice is marked paid.
Retry the payment check and compare the paid invoice with the player's unchanged balance.
item.surface: CryptoBot/xRocket deposit webhook and cashier check
item.title: A paid crypto invoice can be marked credited without giving the player their deposit — invoice status commits before the balance update

item.evidence: slot.php:15 builds links with array_filter(['q' => $q, 'brand' => $b ?? $brand, ...]); :38 passes '' for the all-providers link. PHP's null coalescing retains the empty string, and array_filter removes it; however, if q remains set, the result still filters by q. This does clear the brand, but it does not restore the unfiltered grid when a search is active.
item.expected: R-084: "Choosing the all-providers option in the provider panel clears the filter and returns the grid to the unfiltered first page".
item.observed: UI state, navigation and interaction: when both search and provider filters are active, selecting «Все провайдеры» retains the search query and shows only search matches rather than the requested unfiltered first page. Players must find and manually clear the separate search field.
reproduction_steps: Search for a game on /slot.
Select a provider, then choose «Все провайдеры».
Observe that the search query remains and the grid is still narrowed.
item.title: Players cannot return to the full catalog after choosing a provider — the All option keeps the current brand

item.evidence: slot.php:56 links to /playslot?g=; playslot.php:12-14 sets login for a guest and :48-52 offers only На главную. components/modal.php:2452-2484 reloads the page on login and does not restore an intended game.
item.expected: R-082: "after signing in the visitor is returned to that same game".
item.observed: UI state, navigation and interaction: a guest who follows the card to home and signs in is left on home, not returned to the chosen game; they must find the slot again in the large catalog.
reproduction_steps: Sign out and tap a game on /slot.
On the login-required card select «На главную».
Sign in and observe that home opens rather than the selected slot.
item.title: Guests lose the selected slot when signing in — the login-required card links to home without preserving the game

item.evidence: playslot.php:44-47 only renders the provider iframe; wgc_wallet.php:101-103 updates the stored balance independently. components/footer.php:113-118 renders the balance from the initial PHP page data; script.js:783-806 updates the header only when a caller invokes the balance helpers and playslot.php has no such caller or balance polling.
item.expected: R-090: "After a slot round finishes in /playslot, the RUB balance in the fixed header shows the new stored balance without a manual page reload".
item.observed: UI state, navigation and interaction: after a slot callback changes the player's stored balance, the page header retains its pre-launch amount until a reload or navigation. The player is shown a misleading amount of money while continuing to play.
reproduction_steps: Sign in and open a playable slot.
Complete a bet or win so the provider wallet changes.
Compare the fixed header balance with the stored balance without reloading.
item.title: The slot balance stays stale after a bet or win — the embedded game has no balance refresh path

item.evidence: slot.php:23-28 contains a method=get form, one text input and a search-submit button; its only script at :45-47 handles clicks outside the provider panel, not input changes or clear. inc/wgc.php:89 applies search only on a new server request.
item.expected: R-135: "Typing in the single search field narrows the grid as the player types, a clear control resets it to the full first page".
item.observed: UI state, navigation and interaction: typing does not update the grid until the user submits and reloads the page, and there is no clear control to restore the first page in one click. Browsing a large catalog takes extra repeated submissions.
reproduction_steps: Open /slot and type Sweet without pressing Enter.
Observe the grid remains unchanged.
Submit the search and look for a one-click clear control.
item.title: Players cannot search the slot catalog as they type or clear it in one click — search is only a GET form

item.evidence: slot.php:15 builds links with array_filter(['q' => $q, 'brand' => $b ?? $brand, ...]); :38 passes '' for the all-providers link. array_filter removes the empty brand, but $q remains in the resulting URL.
item.expected: R-084: "Choosing the all-providers option in the provider panel clears the filter and returns the grid to the unfiltered first page".
item.observed: UI state, navigation and interaction: when both search and provider filters are active, selecting «Все провайдеры» clears the provider but retains the search query and shows only search matches rather than the requested unfiltered first page. Players must find and manually clear the separate search field.
reproduction_steps: Search for a game on /slot.
Select a provider, then choose «Все провайдеры».
Observe that the search query remains and the grid is still narrowed.
item.title: Choosing All Providers does not restore the full catalog — the link retains the previous search

item.evidence: dizmaname1.sql:230-234 and dump_all.sql:1434 define kot_user.balance as VARCHAR(50). payapi.php:55 rounds $sum, and :66 interpolates it as a quoted string in WHERE id='$uid' AND balance >= '$sum'; :70 records the withdrawal after the update. For example, string '90' compares greater than string '500' even though 90 RUB is insufficient.
item.expected: Checklist, Business logic and calculations: "Each calculation follows the rule ... at zero, negative, boundary ... values"; users rely on: "withdrawals cannot exceed the available balance". Store balances as decimal/minor units and compare numerically in the atomic debit.
item.observed: Payments and billing: when a configured crypto withdrawal method is available, a player with a smaller balance whose first digit sorts after the amount's first digit can submit a larger withdrawal. The balance becomes negative while a payout request for the full sum is created; if approved, the operator pays money the account did not hold. The behavior is a source prediction based on the supplied VARCHAR schema.
reproduction_steps: With a configured crypto payout method, sign in as a player with 90 ₽ and no outstanding wager.
In Касса → Вывод, request 500 ₽ and provide a valid Telegram ID.
The string predicate allows the debit and the request appears for administrator approval.
item.title: Players can request a payout larger than their balance — the atomic withdrawal compares two strings instead of RUB amounts

item.evidence: action.php:2236-2242 checks existing activation and daily count before writing; :2248 updates the promo limit without an atomic per-user constraint; :2251-2252 credits the balance and inserts the activation independently. admin/migrations.php:99-110 defines indexes on (user_id, created_at) and promo_id but no unique (user_id, promo_id).
item.expected: R-099: "A promo code can be activated once per user ... and a fourth different code within 24 hours is refused"; checklist, Data, persistence and APIs: "a check before insert alone lets two simultaneous requests both insert".
item.observed: Business logic and calculations: concurrent activations from two separate sessions for the same account can both pass the prechecks and credit the same code twice, or allow more than three distinct daily codes. This gives the player unearned money and makes activation limits unreliable; the separate writes can also leave a credit without its activation row.
reproduction_steps: Sign in to the same player account in two independent browser sessions.
Submit the same unused promo code in both sessions at nearly the same time.
Both requests can pass the initial checks before either inserts an activation.
item.title: A player can receive the same promo bonus more than once — eligibility checks and balance credit are not atomic

item.evidence: wgc_wallet.php:88-90 looks up duplicates solely by tx_id; :108 reads roundId, and :110 inserts it without checking for an existing bet for the round. admin/migrations.php:130,145-146 makes tx_id unique but round_id merely a non-unique index.
item.expected: R-092: "Two wallet callbacks carrying the same round id apply the bet or win exactly once"; R-096 requires progress once per round.
item.observed: Business logic and calculations: if a replay or duplicate operation for the same round is delivered under a different transaction ID, it is treated as a new bet/win and its balance and wager effect are applied again. A player can be debited or credited twice and the round ledger is wrong; this condition depends on the provider's callback identifiers.
reproduction_steps: Play a slot round with an accepted writeBet callback.
Have the provider deliver the same round operation again with a distinct transaction identifier.
Compare the stored balance and wager progress against one application of the round.
item.title: A duplicated slot round can debit or credit a player twice — wallet deduplication checks only transaction ID

item.evidence: action.php:1645-1655 accepts newPass and writes it to the current session's user without asking for the existing password or checking a CSRF token. inc/site_config.php:54-73 resolves the session account. The handler is directly reachable as an action POST even if the visible form is not used.
item.expected: Checklist, Auth, sessions and access control: "Changing the email or password asks for the current password"; "Every client-side check has its server-side twin."
item.observed: Auth, sessions and access control: anyone who gains access to an unlocked signed-in browser session can replace that player's password without knowing it; a cross-site submission also lacks a server-side CSRF defense. The legitimate player can be locked out of a real-money account and its balance.
reproduction_steps: Sign in to a player account.
While the session is active submit resetPassPanel with a new password, without supplying the existing password.
Sign out and sign in with the replacement password.
item.title: A signed-in player's password can be replaced without the old password — the server accepts an unverified password change

item.evidence: inc/wgc.php:87-93 counts and pages WHERE removed=0 AND kind='slot' [and brand/search] ORDER BY sort DESC, name; admin/migrations.php:112-125 creates only PRIMARY KEY(public_id) and KEY(kind, brand). slot.php:13 also groups all nonremoved slot brands and computes MAX(sort).
item.expected: R-129: "A page ... answers ... using the stored indexes rather than loading the whole catalog"; checklist, Performance and resource leaks: index each repeated filter, sort and lookup.
item.observed: Performance and resource leaks: every catalog page and provider-panel request scans and/or sorts the matching catalog because the supplied index does not cover removed, sort and name in display order. With roughly 17,000 slots, each navigation incurs work proportional to the catalog; search with a leading wildcard likewise cannot use a conventional name index.
reproduction_steps: Open /slot over a populated provider catalog.
Change page or provider and repeat while the catalog grows.
Each request executes the count, ordered page and grouped provider queries.
item.title: Catalog pages become slower as games accumulate — the listing filter and ordering lack a matching index

item.evidence: slot.php:56-59 renders only a link and img, putting name and brand in the title attribute and alt; index.php:121-124 does the same for the home grid. No ordinary outside-image name or provider is rendered.
item.expected: R-075: "the name is rendered as ordinary text outside the image area"; R-134: "Each slot tile ... shows the game name and its provider as text outside the image".
item.observed: Layout, theme, visuals and UX: names and provider labels are not visible beside the artwork; a touch user cannot see a hover title to distinguish similar games. The player must open tiles or use search to identify the intended title.
reproduction_steps: Open /slot on a phone.
Compare games with similar artwork; look for their name and provider outside each picture.
item.title: Players cannot distinguish similarly illustrated games from visible labels — the tile keeps names only in title and alt attributes

item.evidence: inc/wgc.php:55 removes the time limit, :59-63 loops on each page and on HTTP 429 sleeps two seconds then continues without incrementing a retry counter; admin/admin_func.php:183-187 waits synchronously for wgc_sync, and admin/slots.php:75-82 disables the initiating button until the request resolves.
item.expected: Checklist, UI state, navigation and interaction: "a poll or retry has a cap and hands control back with an error"; third-party provider failures must reach the user visibly.
item.observed: Third-party integrations: if WGC keeps returning rate-limit responses, catalog synchronization retries forever and the administrator receives neither completion nor an actionable error; the PHP worker remains occupied and the button remains in its syncing state.
reproduction_steps: As administrator choose full or delta synchronization.
If the provider persistently returns HTTP 429, wait for the sync.
The retry loop has no cap or error return.
item.title: Catalog synchronization can hang indefinitely under provider rate limiting — retries have no limit
